outcome: expression of integrin beta3 and LIF in the decidua
cohort: 20 women with cesarean scar pregnancy and 20 women with normal pregnancies.
finding: The increased expression of integrin beta3 and LIF in the cesarean scar decidua may be associated with embryo implantation in the cesarean scar, suggesting that the occurrence of CSP might be related to changes in endometrial receptivity in the local cesarean scar.
